additional_requirements: The binge eating occurs, on average, at least once a week for 3 months

S049.name: Eating_Large_Amount
S049.description: Eating, in a discrete period of time, an amount of food that is definitely larger than what most individuals would eat in a similar period of time under similar circumstances.
examples: Eating more than 3-4 times the amount of a typical meal within 2 hours.
Continuously eating large amounts of high-calorie snacks in addition to main meals.
Eating enough to empty a significant portion of the refrigerator or pantry at once.
Eating clearly more food than others during the same period of time.

S050.name: Loss_of_Control
S050.description: A sense of lack of control over eating during the episode (e.g., a feeling that one cannot stop eating or control what or how much one is eating).
examples: A feeling that once I start eating, I cannot stop even if I want to.
Thinking 'I shouldn't eat any more' but mechanically continuing to eat.
A feeling of helplessness that I cannot decide for myself how much to eat.
Eating as if my body is being controlled by someone else.

S051.name: Rapid_Eating
S051.description: Eating much more rapidly than normal.
examples: Swallowing food without chewing it properly.
Eating continuously and rapidly to the point where it is difficult to breathe.
Eating so urgently that there is no time to taste the food.
Eating at a speed that surprises others.

S052.name: Eating_Until_Uncomfortably_Full
examples: Eating until the stomach feels distended to the point of bursting and pain.
Eating so much that it is difficult to even stand up or move.
Continuing to eat until feeling nauseous or like vomiting.
Unable to stop eating even though it is physically uncomfortable and painful.

S055.name: Negative_Affect_After_Binge
S055.description: Feeling disgusted with oneself, depressed, or very guilty afterward.
examples: Feeling unbearable disgust and self-loathing after binging.
Falling into extreme depression and self-criticism immediately after binging.
Feeling intense guilt and regret over the fact that I binged again.
Feeling shame that I am pathetic and have weak willpower after binging.

patient_info.stressor: Magin strained his back during a loading-yard incident shortly before he was supposed to begin mentoring a new group of drivers, abruptly taking him off the road and disrupting the routines that had organized his days for decades. During three months of recovery at home, his solitary cooking shifted from careful meal preparation into repeated episodes where he ate very large portions of pozole, tamales, snacks, and leftovers much faster than usual, continuing until he was uncomfortably full and feeling unable to stop once he had started. Because he lived alone after his divorce, the pattern stayed hidden, but the guilt and disgust afterward became harder for him to square with his disciplined identity as a safety-minded driver and mentor. He disclosed the eating pattern during a follow-up visit for his injury after the clinician asked how he was coping with being off work, leading to referral for psychiatric care.

S049.name: Eating_Large_Amount
S049.description: Eating, in a discrete period of time, an amount of food that is definitely larger than what most individuals would eat in a similar period of time under similar circumstances.
S049.manifestation: Some evenings I’ll heat up what I swear is just one bowl of pozole, and before I know it I’ve gone through the pot, a couple tamales, chips, and whatever leftovers are sitting there like I’m feeding a whole crew instead of just myself.

S050.name: Loss_of_Control
S050.description: A sense of lack of control over eating during the episode (e.g., a feeling that one cannot stop eating or control what or how much one is eating).
S050.manifestation: Once I start, it feels like the same discipline I had on the road just shuts off, and even while I’m telling myself, 'Magin, put the fork down,' my hand keeps going back for more.

S051.name: Rapid_Eating
S051.description: Eating much more rapidly than normal.
S051.manifestation: I eat so fast it’s like I’m on a tight delivery schedule, barely tasting it and sometimes catching myself breathing hard because I’m shoveling food in without slowing down.

S052.name: Eating_Until_Uncomfortably_Full
S052.manifestation: I’ll keep eating until my stomach is stretched and hurting, and with this bad back I end up stuck in the recliner feeling miserable because even getting up feels like too much.

S055.name: Negative_Affect_After_Binge
S055.description: Feeling disgusted with oneself, depressed, or very guilty afterward.
S055.manifestation: What brings me in is that after I do it, I sit there looking at the empty containers and I feel disgusted with myself, like I’m not the steady, in-control man I’ve always tried to be.

additional_requirement_1.name: Additional Requirement 1
additional_requirement_1.description: The binge eating occurs, on average, at least once a week for 3 months
additional_requirement_1.manifestation: Since I’ve been home with my back injury, it’s been happening several nights most weeks; I can’t think of a single week in these three months where I didn’t have at least one of those episodes.

functional_impairment.name: Functional Impairment
functional_impairment.manifestation: I’ve started avoiding check-in calls from the drivers I was supposed to mentor because I feel ashamed and don’t want anyone hearing how far off my routine I’ve gotten.

duration.name: Duration
duration.manifestation: This has been going on since I strained my back and got taken off the road about three months ago.
